title: dryopteris crinipes
intro: Dryopteris crinipes, commonly known as the Hair fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of fern that is native to East Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Dryopteris crinipes include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antibacterial, antiviral, and antifungal properties.
